title: Buying from Aquemi: terms, payment and onboarding | Aquemi
meta: Terms every Aquemi proposal states on page one, and how we answer your URS or RFQ line by line. Capital request notes, onboarding papers and ordering.
headline: How buying from us works
lead: Terms for buying our polypropylene Purified Water package, written for procurement, finance and approvers. Every proposal opens with them. Send your contract form: any clause we cannot accept is listed once, with its reason.
primary_cta_intent: I have an RFQ or a tender

blocks.h: Comparing quotes on the same lines
blocks.intro: Quotes differ most in what they leave out. Level every quote on these lines before you compare prices.

Included, a priced option, or left to you?
Counted from shipment, or from acceptance on your site?

blocks.intro: Procurement checks these before award. Each shows its status today; ask for any of them with your RFQ.

items.d: Status: [certificate of insurance status]. Limits are in our company facts.

Business number and sales tax account: [tax registration status]
Your form completed, or our pack, from [quality system ready for audit, date]

blocks.intro: Four steps, from your purchase order to the start of the lead-time clock. Our bank details never change by email: call [sales phone number] before acting on such a request.

items.d: Make the purchase order (PO) out to [legal entity name]. Quote our proposal number, so price and scope carry over.
Public buyers: add your PO, tender and project numbers. We repeat them on every invoice.
Within [order confirmation time, working days]: order accepted, drawing schedule and one named contact.
Lead time counts from your order and from approved drawings, as page one states.

items.q: Can you sign our contract form?
items.a: Send it with your RFQ. Our proposal lists any clause we cannot accept, once, with the reason. Our standing positions: [contract form positions].

items.q: Do you bid on public tenders paid after acceptance?
items.a: [public tenders paid after acceptance, yes or no]. Where we bid, we bid on your terms and attach no terms of our own. A clause we cannot meet is raised in your question period [confirm].

Each package is built for one site, from your approved drawings. Its material is bought then. Whether a payment falls there: [deposit, if any, and its event]. Every later payment follows an event you can check, such as a passed FAT [confirm].
Three conditions, all written in your proposal. Feed water stays inside the design basis, the daily log is kept, and changes are agreed with us first. [warranty conditions to confirm]

items.q: Can you bid where references are required?
items.a: None yet: we are a new company with no client reference to name. Name what the reference should prove, and check that directly. Talk today to the engineer who would lead your project. Audit our quality system from [quality system ready for audit, date]. Witness your FAT once [shop and test bay ready for visits].
